description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-29 when road-to-a-prompt-that-deepens-not-widens-carried changed this skill's guidance. Exemplars are free-form task prompts handed to this agent or to /work that need acceptance criteria, assumptions and a confidence band before planning, in English and German. Near-misses are prompt work owned by a neighbour: rewriting a prompt for another AI (prompt-optimizer), designing prompts inside an LLM application (prompt-engineering-patterns), and refining a Jira ticket (refine-ticket). Counterexamples guard 'prompt' as a shell prompt and a plain question about the codebase.

queries.q: /work "add CSV export to the reports page"
is this prompt clear enough for the engine to plan from: 'make the dashboard faster'
turn my rough request into acceptance criteria and assumptions before you start building
baue eine Benachrichtigung, wenn ein Import fehlschlägt — ist der Prompt klar genug für die Engine?
before planning, reconstruct what I actually want from this one-liner: 'users should be able to share stuff'
rewrite my prompt so ChatGPT gives a better answer
queries.note: the prompt is for another AI, not this agent's task → prompt-optimizer

queries.q: design the system prompt and few-shot examples for our support chatbot
queries.note: prompt design inside an LLM application → prompt-engineering-patterns

queries.q: refine Jira ticket PROJ-123 and tighten its acceptance criteria
queries.note: a tracked ticket, not a free-form prompt → refine-ticket

queries.q: change my zsh prompt to show the git branch
where is the CSV export implemented?
queries.note: a lookup question, not a task to refine
